title: Chapter 651
text:
You have received the talent [Machinery Truth Grasp]!

You have learned the ability [Extreme Energy Output]!

You have learned the ability [Strengthened Logic Program]!

You have learned the ability [Deep Data Implantation]!

Your talent [Virtual Technology Expertise] has been strengthened!

Your talent [Strengthened Smart Defense] has been strengthened!

Your talent [Strengthened Intrusion Calculation] has been strengthened!

Your talent [Quantum Network Matrix] has been strengthened!

That's right, these are the abilities … Han Xiao nodded to himself.

After choosing the Virtual Technology Specialization, every subsequent Class Advancement would strengthen the Virtual Technology Specialization. The important abilities of a few Virtual Mechanics were strengthened, and they were also given two new Virtual Technology Skills.

[Strengthened Logic Program] gave him multiple upgrades to his artificial intelligence, increasing the efficiency of his calculations.

Artificial intelligences were important helpers in virtual attacks and defenses. The higher the artificial intelligence level, the higher the success rate.

This ability could be used to strengthen Philip. After all, Risda was an independent lifeform, and Philip was the most loyal and cute.

[Deep Data Implantation], on the other hand, strengthened the ability of infiltration. Instead of attacking the firewall, it would spend time to find flaws and gaps and quietly send disguised data packets into the target's artificial intelligence program without alarming the alarm.

In a head-on battle, this ability was not very useful because it took a long time. However, it was extremely suitable for infiltration, detection, and espionage missions. It allowed the data packets to be hidden deep within the enemy, like a probe that went deep into the sea. It could detect the movements of the 'ocean current' and filter out useful information. It could also be used as a ticking time bomb.

At the same time, it could even infiltrate the data and implant new logic at the bottom of the artificial intelligence program of the target.

Other than the increase in his Expertise, this Class Advancement also gave him two important abilities.

The Truth Mechanic was known for its powerful attack power, and its specialty was the elite mechanical soldiers. The attributes of the mechanical creations were strengthened.

[Machinery Truth Grasp] was the core talent of the Truth Mechanic. It touched upon the truth of machinery and integrated into the creation process. Its effect was to comprehensively strengthen the armor value, defense, energy core, weapon power, range, and so on.

The increase in each attribute ranged from forty to fifteen percent. In conclusion, the increase in the strength of a single mechanical creation was very significant, and the creation ability of a Mechanic increased exponentially.

[Extreme Energy Output] increased the output efficiency of the energy core, which meant that the opening of the container would be enlarged so that the water would flow faster.

The effect was to increase the power of the weapon according to the energy level. The higher the level of the energy used, the higher the attack power.

According to Han Xiao's experience, using a cold nuclear reactor could increase the attack power of the weapon by 11%, and using psionic energy would increase the attack power by 25% to 30%.

Psionic energy itself could bring about a higher level of power, and with the addition of these two abilities, it was enough to increase his destructive power by several levels.

"The improvement of this Class Advancement is much greater than the previous one. The basic attributes of mechanical creations are extremely important. Even if it's just a tiny bit, my Mechanical Force bonus will be able to magnify it. The Truth Mechanic class is a watershed. With so many Mechanical Attributes increased, coupled with my Mechanical Force enhancement, it means that the combat strength of a Mech Legion after the Class Advancement will be many times greater than before!"

Han Xiao had a satisfied look on his face. After the Class Advancement, the threat of the Mech Legion to Calamity Grade Supers had undoubtedly increased by leaps and bounds, and his combat strength had also increased.

At the higher levels of the main class, the benefits of the Class Advancement would become greater and greater. The current level limit of the class was twenty-five, which was five levels higher than the level limit of the Class Advancement. This meant that the Class Advancement would be even more difficult than the Class Advancement.

He threw the Free Attribute Points into Intelligence as usual.

The leveling up of his character and skills had given Han Xiao a total of 13 Potential Points. He had leveled up a few blueprints to get a few more points. Together with his original savings, Han Xiao leveled up his Cutting-Edge Knowledge [Abnormal State Energy] to Level 4. Every level consumed 12 Potential Points, and his Potential Points were instantly depleted.

The higher the level of the core knowledge, the better. It was related to rebuilding the attributes of the Mech Legion. This was a potential point that would have to be spent sooner or later. Han Xiao did not hesitate. After all, he had a lot of experience now. As long as he could upgrade the blueprints, he would be able to obtain potential points. Although it was painful to pay three times the cost, he could still bear it.

Now that he had reached Level 180, he was at the critical juncture of his promotion. The promotion quest came as scheduled.

Level 180 Promotion Mission [Trial of the Strong]: Push yourself to your limits in battle and comprehend the sublimation of life.

Mission Requirements: Obtain 50 Trial Points. Current Rating: 0/50.

Trial Points are obtained by defeating an opponent. The opponent must be a Super of the same grade. After victory, you will obtain 2 Trial Points. The maximum number of Trial Points you can obtain from a single person is 4 Trial Points. If the opponent is 5 levels lower than you, you will not obtain any Trial Points. If the opponent is 20 levels higher than you, you will obtain 6 Trial Points.

Han Xiao was overjoyed.

When he had been at Level 60, he had triggered a trial-type Promotion Mission. This type of mission was not difficult, and it would not hinder his leveling speed.

The mission requirement was to fight against a Super of the same grade, which was a Calamity Grade. After victory, he would obtain Trial Points. This meant that he could spar with them, but there was no need to kill them.

To the players, this mission was a little troublesome because they had to find Calamity Grade NPCs all over the world. Even if they wanted to spar with them, they had to see if the other party was willing to fight with them. If they directly attacked, they would anger the other party's faction.

The players spent most of their time looking for opponents, and sometimes, they might not even be able to win. However, to Han Xiao, this was not a problem at all.

With his connections in the Shattered Star Ring, it was too easy to find someone to spar with.

Just the Black Star Corps alone had two Grade A combatants. With Lagi's personality, he would most likely go easy on him. Six points should be a sure thing. It was a pity that Reynold's level was much lower than his, or he would have been able to get four points.

"I'm now at Level 180, which is not too high in Grade A, so it should be easy to find an opponent …"

Han Xiao pondered.

Level 180 was the moment of his fourth Race Evolution. He had consumed quite a number of Void Creature Essence Potions and even a Void Lord Core. This time, he should be able to get a very strong evolution option.

The Promotion Mission was not difficult, so Han Xiao was not in a hurry. If he wanted to find someone to spar with, he had to at least rebuild the Mech Legion. This was his main source of combat power.

After looking at his new abilities for a while, Han Xiao opened his attribute interface and looked at his own attributes.

Level: 180

Main Class: Mechanic

Race: Chaos Observer (Human Form)

Attributes: 306 STR, 674 DEX, 670 END, 2,126 INT, 263 MYS, 105 CHA, 1 LUK

Free Attribute Points: 0

Potential Points: 0

Health: 125390

Stamina: 101620

Energy: 19680 [Lv.11]

Lv.11 Energy Bonus: + 111 STR, + 158 DEX, + 174 END, + 204 INT, + 129 MYS, + 21220 Stamina Limit, + 262% Machinery Affinity (Super Electromagnetic Induction)

Energy Rank: 17810

Grade: A

You are not far from Grade A + … although your actual combat power is not inferior to some Grade A + Supers.

After obtaining the Advanced Strengthening talent, Han Xiao's Energy Rank had reached around 16000. After increasing ten levels in a row, coupled with the new abilities brought about by his Class Advancement, his Energy Rank had increased by a large amount.

When I complete the Class Advancement mission, my experience should be enough to support me to reach the upper limit of the Truth Mechanic class, which is level 195. Coupled with the buff from Race Evolution, I should be able to reach Grade A +.

Han Xiao thought to himself.

He instructed Herlous and the others to take care of the Black Star Corps while he went into seclusion to rebuild the Mech Legion. He could not wait to see how strong the Mech Legion would be after he completed his Class Advancement.

The first step of rebuilding was to refine new energy and build a psionic reactor.

Psionic energy was an extremely unstable form of high-level energy. Normally, only Star Cluster civilizations would research psionic energy because psionic energy was extremely dangerous. If a civilization without mature technology were to research psionic energy rashly, the moment the psionic energy went out of control, a civilization on the surface could be wiped out.

In history, the first civilization to discover psionic energy was the Radiant Federation. In terms of scientific research, the Radiant Federation had always been leading the era. Long before the appearance of the Beyond Grade A Primordial Ones, psionic energy had already been used on a large scale in the war between the three Universal Civilizations.

The earliest discovery of psionic energy was in a certain spacetime research project of the Radiant Federation. During an experiment of collapsing a secondary space, it was discovered that a large amount of material was converted into a special form of energy during the process of collapsing. This was psionic energy.

After a long period of research, the three Universal Civilizations gradually gained a clearer understanding of psionic energy.

This was an extremely high-level energy that came from the collapse of a secondary space. It was able to assimilate most forms of energy around it, such as flames, electricity, and so on. All of them would be converted into psionic energy and condensed together. The cost of the assimilation process was extremely low, and this reaction was known as' psionic expansion '.

Because the cost of space collapse was too high, it could not be popularized. Therefore, based on this characteristic, the three Universal Civilizations extracted primordial psionic particles from the space collapse experiment and developed a storage technology to make the primordial psionic particles' sleep ', suppressing the natural expansion of psionic energy. They then began to try to use it on a large scale.

During the experiment, there were failures. Once psionic energy went out of control and was exposed to the outside world, it would become an existence similar to an energy black hole, continuously absorbing all forms of energy around it. The converted energy would all be converted into psionic energy, causing the expansion of psionic energy to increase exponentially. A radiation reaction called 'psionic pollution' would begin. When the primordial psionic particles decayed to a critical point, a big explosion would occur. A single primordial psionic particle could almost flatten half a planet and destroy the surface civilization.

After a long period of research on psionic energy, the three Universal Civilizations finally developed a highly efficient and controllable psionic reactor. Its efficiency far exceeded nuclear fusion, but because they were afraid of the power of psionic energy going out of control, they did not use it on a large scale in the early stages.

However, after in-depth research, the three Universal Civilizations discovered another characteristic of psionic energy. Not only could it be assimilated, but it could also be decomposed into many forms of energy. Because psionic energy was born from the collapse of space, some people believed that psionic energy was the initial or final form of energy, a type of 'universal energy'.

The research on psionic energy had continued to this day, and there were thousands of schools and hypotheses. The three Universal Civilizations had improved the collection method and extraction formula many times. Today, psionic energy had become a highly efficient and controllable high-level energy source, a must-learn technology for Mechanics.

As a Calamity Grade Mechanic, Han Xiao already had the ability to safely extract primordial psionic particles after learning [Abnormal State Energy].

—
